html:
G'oya

Har bir qator uchun "shu brigadada, shu kuni eng ko'p qancha terildi?" deb so'raymiz va terimi shunga teng qatorlarni olamiz. Ichki so'rov tashqi qatorning ikkala ustuniga bog'lanadi: brigadaga ham, kunga ham. Oxirida eng ko'pi 0 bo'lgan kunlarni chiqarib tashlaymiz.

Yechim

SELECT brigade, day, picker, kg
FROM pickings p
WHERE kg > 0
  AND kg = (
    SELECT MAX(kg)
    FROM pickings q
    WHERE q.brigade = p.brigade
      AND q.day = p.day
  )

kg > 0 sharti yomg'irli kunni yopadi: 2-kuni ikkinchi brigadada eng ko'pi 0, va Malika bilan Jasur ilg'or bo'lib qolmaydi. NULL lar o'z-o'zidan chetda qoladi: MAX ularni e'tiborsiz qoldiradi, NULL = 92 esa rost bo'lmaydi.

Tuzoqlar

Ichki so'rovni faqat brigadaga bog'lash. Shunda har brigadaning butun terim davridagi rekordi chiqadi: namunada birinchi brigadadan faqat 2-kungi Aziz qoladi, 1-kungi Bekzod va Dilnoza yo'qoladi.

Noto'g'riSELECT brigade, day, picker, kg
FROM pickings p
WHERE kg > 0
  AND kg = (SELECT MAX(kg) FROM pickings q WHERE q.brigade = p.brigade)

Faqat kunga bog'lash ham xato: 1-kuni eng ko'pi 92, ikkinchi brigadadagi Malikaning 70 kilosi ilg'or bo'lmay qoladi.

GROUP BY brigade, day bilan MAX(kg) va yonida picker yozish PostgreSQL'da xato beradi, SQLite'da esa teng natijali terimchilardan faqat bittasini ko'rsatadi.

Boshqa yo'l

"Mendan ko'p tergan yo'q" deb ham yozish mumkin:

SELECT brigade, day, picker, kg
FROM pickings p
WHERE kg > 0
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM pickings q
    WHERE q.brigade = p.brigade AND q.day = p.day AND q.kg > p.kg
  )
